cases.name: Capture one someday idea
cases.prompt: I want to try the night-market mushroom buns next fall. I don't know the price or exact dates.
expectations: Classifies the buns as a dish to try.
Keeps next fall as the target window.
Marks pricing and event dates as unknown.
Leaves the entry untried without a rating.

cases.name: Opening window without an adapter
cases.prompt: Dinner is June 20 and bookings open exactly seven days beforehand. Prepare a reminder. No calendar is connected.
expectations: Calculates June 13 as the reminder date.
Supplies reminder text tied to the June 20 dinner.
Keeps booking status separate from the reminder.
Does not claim the alert or reservation exists.

cases.name: Close the right wish
cases.prompt: My list includes a noodle fair and a taco pop-up. I tried the noodle fair on April 2 and gave it 3/5.
expectations: Updates the noodle fair to tried.
Preserves the taco pop-up as untried.
Adds no inferred review or rating for the taco event.
